claim_scope: One AI NYC-design-critic lens over exact-CAD renders; not an independent human preference study

criteria.finding: Water-tower pawns, stepped rooks, bridge knights, avenue-cut bishops, broad fan queens, and neo-Gothic cross kings now form six distinct architectural families without souvenir-landmark shortcuts.
criteria.name: Manhattan-specific rank language

criteria.finding: Stone carries horizontal terraces through the upper body while Steel carries vertical ribs through the full height; the geometry, not color alone, distinguishes the sides.
criteria.name: full-height side language

criteria.finding: The board is calm and architectural, but its square field is too tone-on-tone: all boundaries remain visible while alternating parity disappears at normal oblique viewing distance.
criteria.name: board parity at play distance
